app_description:
<p>🧟 <strong>Last Day on Earth</strong> is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world 🌍 where you fight zombies 🧟‍♂️, craft weapons 🔫, and build shelters 🏚️ to stay alive. Explore dangerous lands, gather resources, and team up with other survivors to endure the chaos! ⚔️</p>
